question: Within the field of bacteriology, what statement is valid in relation to the phenomenon of phage conversion ?:

options.opa: It is a consequence of infection by a lytic phage.
options.opb: It does not imply genotypic alterations.
options.opc: It involves the lysogenization of the bacteria by a phage.
options.opd: It does not imply phenotypic alterations.
options.ope: It is a specialized process of conjugation.
